$comment_plan: qb-price-revision SFDMU data plan (todo 314): CPI (Price Index) and Flat price revision. IndexRate rows feed Index_Rate_Decision_Table (refresh it after loading); PriceRevisionPolicy rows are picked on a renewal line or a ramp segment. Region has no defined values; 'US' was accepted on every org probed, other values only where the picklist is unrestricted (see README).

objects.$comment: One row per year for Region US. Effective ranges for one region must not overlap (Help: Use the Price Revision Element in a Pricing Procedure). Rates are illustrative demo values.
objects.query: SELECT CurrencyIsoCode, IsActive, Name, Rate, Region, UsageType, ValidEndDate, ValidStartDate FROM IndexRate WHERE UsageType = 'Pricing' AND Name LIKE 'QB %' ORDER BY Name ASC

objects.$comment: PolicyAdjustment in the formula is the line's UnitPriceUplift; PriceIndex is the Index_Rate_Decision_Table rate for the policy's Region.
objects.query: SELECT CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Formula, Name, PolicyType, Region FROM PriceRevisionPolicy WHERE Name LIKE 'QB %' ORDER BY Name ASC
